        Path(ARTIFACTS) / matches[0]["array_file"], allow_pickle=False
    ).astype(np.float64).reshape(-1)

def vector_cosine(x, y):
    denominator = np.linalg.norm(x) * np.linalg.norm(y)
    return float(np.dot(x, y) / denominator) if denominator else None

normalization_audit = []

    normalization_audit.append({
        "id": rid,

                "input_ids_sha256", "rendered_chat_sha256",

            ]

        "equal_mlp_inputs": equal_inputs,
        "predicted_raw_delta_norm": float(np.linalg.norm(predicted)),

        "normalization_input_norms": [

        "normalization_output_delta_norm": float(np.linalg.norm(dy)),
        "normalization_delta_gain": float(np.linalg.norm(dy) / np.linalg.norm(dx)),
        "residual_delta_norm": float(np.linalg.norm(dh)),
        "normalization_vs_residual_delta_cosine": vector_cosine(dy, dh),
        "residual_minus_normalization_delta_norm": float(np.linalg.norm(dh - dy)),
        "fresh_W0": b["diagnostic_generation"]["text"],
        "fresh_R22": e["diagnostic_generation"]["text"]
